clue.text: Its root is used in the preparation of a certain savoury dish

indicators.note: a dish in preparation has its ingredients mixed, so these two words have their letters stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A cookery note that some root vegetable goes into a savoury dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the preparation of' rearranges the seven letters of ITS ROOT; 'is used' is linking.
explanation.definitionFit: This Italian rice dish, cooked slowly in stock, is a classic savoury meal.

clue.text: Going for restoration

definitions.meaning: to repair to a place is to go there, so this sense is a betaking oneself somewhere
mending something broken or worn, putting it back in order

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the old verb for heading somewhere, the other is mending; both are spelt the same.

clue.text: Refuse to watch absorbing comedian

indicators.note: one word soaking up another means the second sits inside the first

parts.note: to watch is to see
a wag is a joker or comedian

explanation.surface: A refusal to watch a show that features a particular comedian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' looks like a verb but is the noun, waste matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Waste water and filth from drains is a kind of household rubbish.

clue.text: The usual stall to be seen at a road-side

parts.note: a market stall is a stand
RD is the ... abbreviation for road, the word the hyphenated phrase starts with

explanation.surface: A typical stall found at the edge of a road.
explanation.definitionFit: What is normal or customary is the norm, the accepted level.

clue.text: Giving no signal

parts.note: read as a driver failing to indicate, but really the gesture that signals the word no

explanation.definitionFit: Turning one's head from side to side is the usual gesture meaning refusal.

clue.text: A superior's sound assistants

indicators.note: sound tells us the words are spoken, giving something that sounds the same

parts.note: a superior is a better, so this phrase is a better's

explanation.surface: A boss's reliable helpers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like it means reliable but signals that 'a better's' said aloud gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who abet help or encourage another, usually in wrongdoing.

clue.text: Figure involved in a great Venetian stratagem

indicators.note: being involved in something here means sitting inside it

parts.note: the Doge was the elected ruler of Venice
D is the Roman numeral for 500, a figure

explanation.surface: A person caught up in a grand Venetian scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Figure' looks like a person but is a numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: A trick or evasive ruse is a crafty scheme.

clue.text: Run over a note on evidence

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece written on another sits above it

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
a trace is a sign or piece of evidence left behind

explanation.surface: A lawyer reviewing a note about some evidence.
explanation.definitionFit: To go back over a route or a sequence again is to follow it once more.

clue.text: Simple embracing is no trick!

indicators.note: one word embracing another holds it inside

parts.note: mere means simple or nothing more than

explanation.surface: An exclamation that simplicity is not a con.
explanation.walkthrough: In solo whist this is a bid to take no tricks at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A card-game contract in which the bidder undertakes to win nothing.

clue.text: Need coat in new fashion — or that's the tale

indicators.note: making something in a new fashion reshapes it, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A remark that wanting a fashionable coat is a familiar story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in new fashion' rearranges NEED COAT; 'or that's the' is linking.
explanation.definitionFit: A short amusing story about a real incident.

clue.text: The cat confronting a large bird intended to make a kill

parts.note: a tom is a male cat
a hawk is a large bird of prey

explanation.surface: A cat facing up to a big bird of prey ready for the kill.
explanation.definitionFit: A light axe used as a weapon, designed for striking a deadly blow.

clue.text: Having to walk back when there's something afoot

indicators.note: walking back means going the other way, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: to pace is to walk

explanation.surface: Someone forced to walk home because something is going on.
explanation.definitionFit: A reinforced cap over the front of a boot, literally on the foot.

clue.text: A way to encourage the caviar-producer

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
to urge on is to encourage

explanation.surface: A method of egging on a supplier of caviar.
explanation.definitionFit: Caviar is the roe of this large fish.

clue.text: A worker in bed

parts.note: seems a lazy employee lying in, but means someone who works in a flower bed

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who tends plants works in borders and flower beds.

clue.text: Never turning brown, so may be pine

definitions.text: Never turning brown, so may be pine

parts.words: Never turning brown, so may be pine
parts.note: describes a tree that keeps its leaves green all year, as a pine does

explanation.definitionFit: Trees that keep foliage through winter, like conifers, never go brown.

clue.text: The beast is tall and no mistake!

indicators.note: a mistake jumbles things, so the letters of the words go wrong

explanation.surface: Someone insisting an animal really is tall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and no mistake' reads as 'definitely'; 'mistake' rearranges IS TALL NO, with 'and' linking.
explanation.definitionFit: An uncastrated male horse is a powerful animal.

clue.text: Get lit up in the club right enough!

annotationWithheld.why: Get lit up in the club right enough (8): BRIGHTEN; no parse found for 'in the club right enough' giving B-RIGHT-EN, possibly OCR damage
annotationWithheld.clue: Get lit up in the club right enough!

clue.text: Go on about a member's disturbing behaviour

indicators.note: one word placed about another surrounds it

parts.note: to rage is to go on angrily
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Ranting about a politician's unsettling conduct.
explanation.definitionFit: Violent, wild, uncontrolled conduct is a frenzy.

clue.text: Restricted a girl in the first place

indicators.note: one piece in another means placed within it

parts.note: to be in the first place is to have led
she is a girl or woman

explanation.surface: A girl held back at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Kept on a lead like a dog, so held in check.

clue.text: Amplifies general's orders

indicators.note: orders here means rearranges into a new order

explanation.surface: A general's commands boost something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'orders' looks like commands but rearranges GENERALS.
explanation.definitionFit: Makes something bigger, as a photograph is blown up.

clue.text: Field study can be dreary

parts.note: a lea is a meadow or field
a den is a private study

explanation.surface: Fieldwork can be dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy and dull, lacking spirit.

clue.text: Perfume to be returned — many find it unacceptable

indicators.note: something returned goes back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: an aroma is a scent or perfume
L is the Roman numeral for fifty, many

explanation.surface: A scent sent back because many dislike it.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking moral principles, so not acceptable by ethical standards.

clue.text: Gathers in faulty spare parts

indicators.note: faulty parts are wrongly put together, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Collecting broken spare parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Harvests a crop, bringing it in.

clue.text: Capital support for the traveller!

parts.note: capital suggests money or a city, but here means the head, supported for someone on a journey

explanation.definitionFit: A cushion behind a seat on which a passenger leans the head.

clue.text: A lovely garden is featured in display

indicators.note: something featured in another sits inside it

parts.note: a parade is a public display

explanation.surface: A beautiful garden shown in an exhibition.
explanation.definitionFit: Eden, the garden of delight, is the original heavenly place.

clue.text: Flush about the French number

indicators.note: one word placed about another surrounds it

parts.note: flush means level or even
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Something level around the French figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Ten plus one is a counting quantity.

clue.text: A child among children, though mature

indicators.note: something among others sits within them

parts.note: seed is an old word for offspring or children
a son is a child

explanation.surface: A child mixing with children yet grown up.
explanation.definitionFit: Experienced and matured over time, like aged wood.
